maya: Heads-up — scheduling a planned maintenance window for control-plane bare‑metal rack `rack-cp-12`

maya: Window: Tue 02:00 UTC (2h window) — rolling cordon/drain + soft-reboots, staggered to avoid losing quorum. Expected: brief API control-plane latency spikes, normal inference workloads unaffected but control-plane ops (task creation, routing changes) may see ~30–90s delays per node.

tony: Is this purely control-plane nodes? any chance GPUs are touched? :thinking:

maya: purely control-plane / kube-control nodes. No GPU compute nodes will be rebooted. That said, cache/kv warmups may cause brief tail latencies for some hosted requests. We'll preseed kv cache after each node comes back.

jamie: Plan for stagger and backfill? suggest 3 node cohorts, 10m delay between cohorts, preheat KV for 15m after each cohort. Also add route fallback to regional control-plane in case we see quorum blips.

maya: plan: cohorts of 3, stagger 10m, kv-preseed job triggered automatically. Runbook step:
```
infra-drain --rack rack-cp-12 --cohort-size 3 --stagger 600 --kv-preseed 900
```
Followed by `infra-verify-controlplane` to confirm pod health.

liam: Need SRE signoff on fallback routing. Who owns the canary? I can run a synthetic to check control-plane op latency after first cohort.

maya: @liam that would be great — canary after cohort1 for 20m. If 95th p99 of control-plane API < 300ms we proceed. If p99 > 800ms we pause and rollback.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Tue 02:00 UTC — maintenance ticket #INC-3221 created. Runbook: https://intra.redwood/ops/runbooks/controlplane-maintenance

kevin: Support: We'll post a short note on status page and email enterprise customers in affected regions 4h before. Also prepare a PSAT template for customers who ping.

sasha: Product: any risk to dedicated/reserved capacity SLA? We need to confirm no scheduled migrations will overlap. Also check Dedicated routing policy so customers don't see elevated latencies.

maya: Confirmed: no migrations. Dedicated pools unaffected; routing policy keeps tenant traffic on compute planes. We'll attach the Dedicated-safe flag in the ticket.

tony: Cost note — fallback to other control-plane region may increase inter-region control-plane traffic. Estimate: ~50k control-plane calls extra during window => negligible billing impact but call it out.

liam: I'll instrument synthetic and post results in this thread 30m before window. Also will prepare immediate rollback steps: `infra-undeploy-drain` and `route-sticky-fallback disable` in case of problems.

maya: Thanks — can we get final ack from SRE + oncall?

liam: ACK (sre). I'll be on-call for the window.

tony: ACK (oncall).

kevin: ACK (support) — status update queued for 4h pre-alert.

maya: Cool. Proceeding with ticket and will trigger automated preseed. I'll post a short post-mortem template link after the window. :thumbsup:

sasha: adding a note to outreach so CS sees it.

ops-bot: Maintenance ticket #INC-3221 updated: state -> scheduled. Notifying paging group: eng-infra-oncall.

maya: Closing loop — runbook pointer again: https://intra.redwood/ops/runbooks/controlplane-maintenance — reach out here if anything changes.
